_comment: Per-zone gathering node pools for OVERWORLD zones. 'slots' is the number of candidate spawn points GatheringNodeManager rolls random walkable tiles for on every zone entry. 'active_percent' is the fraction of those slots that actually spawn a node each visit (Kyle's 'reroll a % every time you leave/re-enter' design). 'table' is a weighted material pool this zone draws from - only early-tier ore/herb materials are wired for Phase 1, other zones are intentionally left out rather than guessed at. Valley of Trials and Razor Hill are both treated as newbie zones (Kyle, 2026-09-12) and deliberately exclude Tin/Mageroyal - those stay Durotar-and-beyond materials. Cave ore pools are NOT authored here - see gathering_manager.py's CAVE_TO_PARENT_ZONE + populate()'s cave branch, which derives a cave's ore table from its own parent zone's 'table' above rather than needing a second copy of the same data. Eastern Kingdoms zones (Deathknell, Eastern Tirisfal, Western Tirisfal, Silverpine North, Silverpine South) are deliberately herb-heavy vs ore (Kyle, 2026-09-12: 'more herb rich than mining rich') - Brill and The Sepulcher are excluded entirely, both are zone.is_town=True (same convention as every other town having no node pool). Deathknell is the Forsaken's tutorial zone (their Valley of Trials equivalent) so it gets the gentlest materials only, same newbie-zone logic as Valley of Trials itself. Northern/Central Barrens stay Early-tier only (Kyle: 'keep some basic in central Barrens') - Southern Barrens and both Ashenvale zones introduce a SLOW creep of Mid-tier materials (Briarthorn, Iron, Silver) at low weight (1, vs Copper's 3) so they show up as genuinely rare finds, not a full tier jump (Kyle, 2026-09-12: 'slow creeping of materials'). Astranaar/Zoram Strand/Splintertree Post excluded as towns, same convention.
